name: concise-output
title: Concise Output
summary: Deliver accurate, action-first responses with concise prose and explicit next steps.

use_when: The user requests concise, direct, no-fluff, or token-efficient responses
The user invokes Concise Output or Bottom Line Up Front
The user prefers action-first, structured replies during compatible interactive coding, debugging, or operations
avoid_when: Compression would omit required detail, safety context, or exact commands
Another response format is explicitly required by the user
